entries.headline: Six transports reported; no coded broadcasts that hour
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne and no coded radio broadcasts heard during that hour. It also referred to a broadcast the previous day.

entries.headline: Transports and North Sea surveillance aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported five U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne, alongside a surveillance aircraft over the North Sea. It said no coded radio broadcasts were detected during that hour.

entries.headline: Five transports and a surveillance aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported five large U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the United States, plus a surveillance aircraft. It described activity as about normal and said no coded radio broadcasts were detected in the preceding hour.

entries.headline: Transports and command aircraft reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported four large U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the United States, alongside an airborne command-and-control jet and a nuclear communications aircraft. The post did not identify their missions.

entries.headline: Transports and radar aircraft reported over the US
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple large U.S. Air Force transport aircraft and an airborne radar aircraft over the continental United States. It described the activity as routine.

entries.headline: Six transports and an F-16 emergency squawk reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the United States and near Korea. It also mentioned an F-16 broadcasting an emergency squawk earlier that day, without confirming the cause or a link to the transports.

entries.headline: Four coded broadcasts and six transports reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported four coded U.S. Air Force radio broadcasts heard that day and six military transport aircraft airborne, including one near Korea and Japan.

entries.headline: AFRICOM strike report relayed
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed an AFRICOM report, credited to @reagan0965, about U.S. strikes targeting al-Shabaab. The visible post did not give the strikes’ location or date.

entries.headline: Coded broadcasts and reconnaissance aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported four coded U.S. Air Force radio broadcasts heard that day and multiple transport and surveillance aircraft airborne over the United States, including two reconnaissance aircraft.

entries.headline: Transport aircraft and a coded broadcast reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported four U.S. Air Force transport aircraft and two specialised military jets airborne over the United States, with one coded radio broadcast heard in the preceding hour.

entries.headline: Transports, radio traffic and regional air activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple large transport aircraft airborne over the United States, a rise in coded military radio broadcasts near Iran, and air activity near Korea and Japan at nearly 4.5 times its usual level. It did not identify a connection between these observations.

entries.headline: Iraq mission report relayed
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed a Stars and Stripes report, credited to @reagan0965, saying the United States had ended its military mission in Iraq. This was attributed third-party reporting, not an observation made by the account.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: P-8 departure alert at Peddikuppam
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an alert showing a P-8 off the ground at Peddikuppam, India. The alert did not identify a callsign or confirm its destination or mission.

entries.headline: P-8 departure alert at Avilala
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an alert showing a P-8 off the ground at Avilala, India. The alert did not identify a callsign or confirm its destination or mission.

entries.headline: CI132 P-8 departure alert at Gijang
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an alert showing a P-8, callsign CI132, off the ground at Gijang, South Korea. Its destination and mission were not confirmed.

entries.headline: GURNY01 P-8 departure alert at Elgin
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an alert showing a P-8, callsign GURNY01, off the ground at Elgin, Great Britain. Its destination and mission were not confirmed.

entries.headline: P-3 departure alert at Kaohsiung
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an alert showing a P-3 off the ground at Kaohsiung, Taiwan. The alert did not identify a callsign or confirm its destination or mission.

entries.headline: Q9 on-ground alert at Adelanto
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an alert listing a Q9 aircraft on the ground at Adelanto, California, United States. The post described it as a civilian-classified General Atomics aircraft; its purpose was not confirmed.

entries.headline: Autonomous Warfare Command report shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a DefenseScoop report about a new U.S. Autonomous Warfare Command intended to integrate military drone operations. This was a linked news report.

entries.headline: Belgian F-16 delivery report shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a report from The Aviationist saying Belgium was preparing to deliver its first three F-16AM/BM jets to Ukraine after delays. The post described preparations, rather than a completed delivery.

entries.headline: P-8 departure alert at Orange Park
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an alert showing a P-8 off the ground at Orange Park, Florida, United States. Its destination and mission were not confirmed.

entries.headline: ASY173 P-8 on-ground alert at Marton
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an alert listing a P-8, callsign ASY173, on the ground at Marton, New Zealand. Its mission and reason for being there were not confirmed.

entries.headline: E-6 departure alert at Moore
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an alert showing an E-6 off the ground at Moore, Oklahoma, United States. The alert did not establish its destination or mission.

entries.headline: B-1 on-ground alert at Highworth
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an alert listing a B-1 on the ground at Highworth, Great Britain. The post did not independently establish the precise site or reason for its presence.
